On scope, `Math.round` and the double-versus-int division subtlety fall under 1.7 and 1.11. Writing the completion for the stated specification fits skill 2.A. The options are parallel one-line expressions, so no length giveaway exists. The item is about 60-100 seconds of work with no arithmetic burden, consistent with the reference pattern. It closely resembles a known College Board sample item on rounding with `Math.round`, so I flag that resemblance but do not treat it as disqualifying.
